title: fix(service-analytics): declare the measured deny on a kernel with no security service, pin it on both in-repo kernels, give the reconcile runner an explicit security double
body:
Fixes #22235

Clause-②: no

Executes the maintainer's ruling B (`6056824332`): deny, as measured, becomes the declaration. On a kernel that registers no `security` service, the analytics read bridges deny, fail-closed, as they already did. The comments and the test header now say so, a pin holds it on both in-repo kernels, and the one in-repo producer registers an explicit security double. No line that decides an answer moves, on any context.

## What changed

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts`: **comments only.** The resolution blocks of the row-scope bridge (near `:556`), the object-level admission bridge (near `:700`) and the field-level and query-side bridges now give the measured classification. ABSENT is reached only by a context that answers a miss with nothing: the package's test doubles do, and no in-repo kernel does. `ObjectKernel` and `LiteKernel` throw on a never-registered name, so the bridges take UNUSABLE and refuse with a located `error`. The same change is made in the two `catch` comments, the two ABSENT-branch comments, the per-query report comment (the block PR #22234 last changed) and the two init-time comments. Proof that only comments moved: a comment-stripped transpile (`ts.transpileModule`, `removeComments`) of the base file and of this head is byte-identical (sha256 prefix `c1a4301c498f8087` both sides, 30086 bytes).
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/admission-bridge-resolution.test.ts`:
  - The header is rewritten to the ruling. The sentence that called a deny on absence wrong is gone.
  - The ABSENT case keeps its assertions. Its title and inline comment now describe the context it actually models, a lookup that answers nothing.
  - A new pin covers both kernels (`describe.each` over `ObjectKernel` and `LiteKernel`), each booted with no `security` service ever registered. It asserts that the kernel's own lookup throws, and that the dataset query is refused with `code: PERMISSION_DENIED`, `status: 403` and `object: employer_member`. It also asserts that nothing was read, and that exactly one `error` line from the object-level bridge names the object and the failed `security` lookup. Finally, it asserts that the ABSENT branch's WARN did not fire.
- `scripts/analytics-reconcile/boot.ts` registers an explicit, OPEN `security` test double as a named plugin. It answers `canReadObject` true, `getReadFilter` undefined (no row restriction) and `getReadableFields` undefined (no answer). The runner compares numbers, not access: its legacy `engine.aggregate()` path runs with no caller context on an engine with no security middleware, so the dataset path gets the same posture, declared by name.

## Hypotheses, measured on `origin/main` `3513ac77`

- **H1, confirmed.** The ABSENT rows at `plugin.ts:556` and `:691` stated "admits" and called a kernel shipping no plugin-security a legitimate configuration. The same claim repeated at the two `catch` comments, the two ABSENT-branch comments, the report block, the field-level and query-side rows, and both init-time comments. All are rewritten, comments only.
- **H2, done.** The header is rewritten and the pin is added. The pin's ablation is below.
- **H3, confirmed, with a refinement.** Driven through `boot.ts`'s own `reconcileApp()` with one dual-form widget (`todo_task` by `status`, `task_metrics` / `task_count`), the composition is denied before this change. The dataset query is refused with `Access denied` and 0 rows, and the bridge logs the UNUSABLE `error`. After the change, the dataset query answers 4 groups whose counts equal the legacy path's (2, 1, 4, 1). Refinement: on `3513ac77` none of the three shipping runners reaches `queryDataset`. `app-todo.ts` boots and skips all 13 widgets and reports as not dual-form, and it exits 0 before and after this change. `app-crm.ts` and `app-showcase.ts` fail `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` on example files that no longer exist (noted below).
- **H4, listed, not edited.** The release-owned sentences are listed below for the docs card.
- **H5** is raised as an open question in the seat report, not built.

## Pin and ablation (head `183709e70c`)

The pin's subject is imported from source (`../plugin.js`), so no `dist` leg applies.

- Green: `vitest run` over the two admission files gives 2 files and 13 tests passed. The new pin is 2 cases.
- Ablation A1 makes the object-level bridge's `catch` classify a throw as ABSENT. It went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `ccecf120ec1d` to `1d21d50d6cea`, with an outer `trap` restore.
  - Result: 4 failed, 9 passed. Both new pins (`ObjectKernel`, `LiteKernel`) are red, together with the double-based throw case here and `admission-absence-report.test.ts`'s real-kernel case.
  - Observed direction: red. The object gate admitted, and the row-scope bridge then refused the same query with `READ_SCOPE_COMPILE_FAILED` / 500, so the declared `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 envelope naming the object was lost.
  - Restore: blob `ccecf120ec1d` equals `HEAD:plugin.ts`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Local verification (head `183709e70c`)

- `@objectstack/service-analytics`:
  - The build exits 0.
  - `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) exits 0. The program includes the test file: `--listFiles` lists `admission-bridge-resolution.test.ts`.
  - `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 180 passed (180). Tests 4443 passed, 262 skipped (4705).
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 66 families for this change set. 65 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, because 37 workspace packages have no `dist/` in this worktree. NOT MEASURED. A targeted substitute reading, a `require()` of this package's `dist/index.cjs`, loads. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 66 derived, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check:type-check-debt`: 26 raw tsc errors, none above the recorded number. `boot.ts` carries the same 8 `TS2307` it carried before this change, and no other diagnostic.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 touched files reports 3 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. The config lints every TS/JS file outside its never-linted list, so all 3 are in scope. It never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on a file it does not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Changeset: none, `skip-changeset`

Nothing this package publishes changes behaviour. Its `files` are `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. After a rebuild, three of the new comment phrases occur in 0 files under `dist/`, while the positive control (a runtime string from the same file) occurs in 2. The test file and `scripts/` are not published.

## Released sentences that state "absent admits": for the docs card, not edited here

`packages/services/service-analytics/CHANGELOG.md`:
- `:583-584`: "A deployment with no security service applies no field-level check, as on the data API."
- `:645-647`: "A deployment with no security service applies no object-level check, as on the data API."
- `:1211-1213`: "A deployment with no security service, and an object the security service gives no field answer for, apply no field-level check, as before."
- `:1926`: "a deployment with no `security` service registered keeps its previous analytics behaviour by design, because on that deployment `/data` carries no object-level gate either and the equivalence is what is being defended."
- `:1930`: "an ABSENT `security` service admits (that deployment has no object-level gate on `/data` either, so the two doors still agree, and this is what keeps a deployment shipping no `plugin-security` working as before)"
- `:1936`: "The object-level bridge tells three resolutions apart — ABSENT admits, THROWING and METHOD-LESS deny at `error`."
- `:1952`: "**ABSENT** — no `security` service resolved: **unchanged**. No row-scope provider on this deployment, which is a legitimate configuration (a single-tenant kernel that ships no `plugin-security` ...) ... ⛔ Deliberately not tightened: refusing here would break every such deployment."
- `:2773`: "a deployment with NO security service still runs unscoped exactly as before."

The same lockstep entry repeats, with the `:1926` and `:1930` sentences, in:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/CHANGELOG.md:1675` and `:1679`
- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:13374` and `:13378`
- `packages/verify/CHANGELOG.md:571` and `:575`

`content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx:482-484`: "A deployment with no `security` service keeps its old behaviour and warns at init; a registered one that cannot be used denies."

## Acceptance notes

- The same declaration repeats outside this card's file surface, in `service-analytics`:
  - the `read-admission.ts` module header (`:59-65`);
  - the `admitObjectRead` and `getReadableFields` docs on `AnalyticsServiceConfig` (`analytics-service.ts` near `:842` and `:862`);
  - the `assertReadAdmitted` doc (near `:1897`);
  - `field-read-admission.ts:339-341`.

  Each equates "no provider wired" with "a deployment with no security service". Through the plugin a provider is always wired. Reported to the seat with the docs card's list, not edited here.
- On a kernel with no security service, the UNUSABLE `error` line reads "A security service is wired on this deployment". The `assertObjectsReadable` denial line that follows reads "the same verdict GET /data/OBJECT reaches". Neither holds on that deployment (measured through `boot.ts` before this change). These are runtime strings, outside this card's comments-only fence, and are reported to the seat.
- `scripts/analytics-reconcile/app-crm.ts` and `app-showcase.ts` import example files that no longer exist (`MODULE_NOT_FOUND`), and `app-todo.ts` has no dual-form widget. So no shipping runner exercises the dataset path. Driving one synthetic dual-form widget showed that the reconcile tool keys a select dimension by stored value on the legacy path and by option label on the dataset path. Counts agree, keys differ. Noted, not filed: no runner reaches it.
